_comment_reVerifySchedule: RE-VERIFY ALL SCHEME DATA EVERY 6 MONTHS (next check: March 2027). State scheme names, amounts, and portals change with budget cycles. The AP and TS schemes were renamed between Sept 2025 and Jan 2026 — this data was corrected September 2026.
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of Rs 2,000 directly to Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable land. Excludes institutional landholders, income tax payers, and serving/retired government officers.
howToApply: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) / e-Sevai centre with Aadhaar and Patta/Chitta land document.
coverage: Over 11 crore farmers enrolled across India. 100% centrally funded DBT.
officialSource: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI (pmkisan.gov.in)

benefit: Comprehensive risk insurance covering pre-sowing failure, standing crop loss, post-harvest losses (up to 14 days), and localized natural disasters.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified food, oilseed, or commercial/horticultural crops in notified insurance units/districts for the specified season.
howToApply: Apply through your primary lending bank (if crop loan availed), nearest CSC, or online at pmfby.gov.in before seasonal cut-off (July 31 for Kharif, Dec 31 for Rabi).
coverage: Farmer pays nominal premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for Annual Commercial/Horticulture crops. Balance paid by Central & State govts.
officialSource: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI (pmfby.gov.in)

benefit: Short-term production credit up to Rs 3 Lakh at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (upon prompt repayment, backed by 3% interest subvention).
eligibility: All owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) involved in crop cultivation.
howToApply: Submit KCC application to any Commercial Bank, Cooperative Bank, or Regional Rural Bank (RRB). One-page simplified form available at myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kcc.
coverage: Credit limit calibrated to scale of finance per acre for the crop, plus 10% for post-harvest expenses and 20% for maintenance of farm assets.
officialRef: Master Circular — Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
documents: Land Ownership Record or Tenant Agreement
No-Dues Certificate / Declaration from other banks

scheme: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation Subsidy)
benefit: 55% capital subsidy for Small & Marginal farmers (<= 2 Hectares / 5 Acres) and 45% for Other farmers on Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: Farmers with an assured water source (borewell, open well, farm pond, or canal) and cultivable land. Preference given to water-stressed and high-efficiency horticultural/cash crops.
howToApply: Apply through State Department of Agriculture / Horticulture portal or District Assistant Director of Horticulture (ADH) office.
coverage: Covers inline drip, micro-sprinklers, portable sprinklers, and semi-permanent irrigation layouts.
officialSource: Dept of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI (pmksy.gov.in)
officialRef: PMKSY Per Drop More Crop Guidelines (5 Ha Ceiling)
documents: Water Source Certificate / Borewell Electricity Proof

benefit: 100% Free laboratory testing of 12 vital macro- and micro-nutrients (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, Organic Carbon) with customized fertilizer dosages.
eligibility: All farmers across India. Testing cycle repeats every 2 years for each farm plot.
howToApply: Submit representative soil samples to the nearest Government Soil Testing Laboratory (STL) or through village Agricultural Extension Officer (AEO). Status trackable on soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
coverage: Issued to over 22 crore farm holdings. Directly curtails over-application of Urea/DAP and reduces cultivation input costs by 15-25%.

benefit: Pan-India electronic trading portal uniting APMC mandis for transparent competitive price discovery, online bidding, and direct bank settlement without middleman fee.
eligibility: Farmers bringing harvest produce to any e-NAM registered APMC mandi. Active in 23 states/UTs with integrated mandis (Excludes states without APMC integration such as Bihar and Kerala).
howToApply: Register online at enam.gov.in or at the e-NAM gate entry counter of the nearest integrated APMC mandi with photo ID and bank details.
coverage: Over 1,360 wholesale mandis connected nationwide. Free quality assaying and electronic weighbridge receipt.

scheme: Tamil Nadu KAVIADP (Kalaignar All Village Integrated Agriculture Development Programme)
benefit: In-kind benefits bundle: certified high-yield seed kits, coconut/fruit plant kits, micro-irrigation systems, battery sprayers, farm pond support, and ₹5,000 vegetable cultivation incentive. Benefits are component-specific, not a single cash transfer.
eligibility: Farmer families residing in selected village panchayats of Tamil Nadu. Programme active in 2,482 panchayats (2024-25) and 2,338 panchayats (2025-26). Priority to SC/ST, women farmers, and small/marginal landholders (<= 5 acres).
howToApply: Contact local Block Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) or Block Horticulture office. Check Uzhavan App or tnagriculture.in for active panchayat lists.
coverage: Implemented across approx. 2,500 village panchayats annually; budget ₹200 Cr (2024-25), ₹269.51 Cr (2025-26). Multi-department convergence scheme.
officialSource: Tamil Nadu Dept of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (tnagriculture.in)
officialRef: G.O. (Ms) No. 71, Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (AP1) Dept — NOTE: Verify G.O. number at district agriculture office; could not confirm from an official TN Govt PDF source directly.
verificationStatus: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED — benefit structure confirmed from official dept sources; specific G.O. reference unconfirmed. Verify at district ADA office.

benefit: Additional Rs 6,000 per year directly from Government of Maharashtra (distributed in 3 installments of Rs 2,000), totaling Rs 12,000/yr when combined with PM-KISAN.
eligibility: All landholding farmers in Maharashtra eligible for and registered under PM-KISAN. Must possess active land 7/12 (Satbara) extract and Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
howToApply: Automatic enrollment for PM-KISAN approved beneficiaries in Maharashtra. Status verifiable on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in.
coverage: Over 90 lakh farmers across all districts of Maharashtra.
officialSource: Government of Maharashtra Agriculture Department / MahaDBT (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)
verificationStatus: CONFIRMED — independently verified against Maharashtra Agriculture Dept and secondary sources. ₹6,000 state + ₹6,000 PM-KISAN = ₹12,000 total confirmed.
documents: Bank Passbook with NPCI Aadhaar Link

scheme: Annadata Sukhibhava (Andhra Pradesh) — formerly YSR Rythu Bharosa
benefit: Annual financial assistance of Rs 20,000 per farmer family (Rs 14,000 from AP State Government + Rs 6,000 PM-KISAN central share), distributed in seasonal installments. NOTE: The previous scheme 'YSR Rythu Bharosa' (₹13,500/yr) was restructured and renamed by the incoming government. If this app previously showed ₹13,500, that figure is now outdated.
eligibility: Farmer families in Andhra Pradesh holding agricultural land. Eligible tenant farmers with valid Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC). Must have Aadhaar-linked bank account and active e-Crop registration.
howToApply: Enrollment through village Rythu Bharosa Kendras (RBKs) and village agriculture assistants. Status at annadathasukhibhava.ap.gov.in or agriculture.ap.gov.in.
coverage: Covers small, marginal, and landowning farmers. Toll-free helpline: 155251.
officialSource: Govt of Andhra Pradesh Dept of Agriculture (annadathasukhibhava.ap.gov.in)
officialRef: Annadata Sukhibhava Scheme — AP Agriculture Dept (2025). Note: scheme renamed from YSR Rythu Bharosa after 2024 state election.
verificationStatus: CORRECTED — Previous data showed wrong scheme name (YSR Rythu Bharosa) and wrong amount (₹13,500). Corrected to Annadata Sukhibhava at ₹20,000/yr.

benefit: Rs 6,000 per acre per crop season (Rs 12,000 per acre per year for both Kharif and Rabi), disbursed as direct DBT into farmer bank accounts. NOTE: The previous 'Rythu Bandhu' scheme (₹5,000/acre/season) was replaced by 'Rythu Bharosa' in January 2025 at ₹6,000/acre/season. If this app previously showed ₹10,000-₹15,000/acre/yr, that was the old Rythu Bandhu figure.
eligibility: Landholding farmers of Telangana with land registered in Bhu Bharati (previously Dharani) portal. Only cultivable/arable agricultural land qualifies. Non-agricultural land (layouts, industrial zones) excluded.
howToApply: Automatic DBT based on Bhu Bharati land records. Register at local Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO) / Praja Palana centre if newly purchased.
coverage: Covers ~65 lakh landholding accounts across Telangana.
officialSource: Govt of Telangana Agriculture & Cooperation Dept (rythubharosa.telangana.gov.in). Old URL rythubandhu.telangana.gov.in is now defunct.
officialRef: Rythu Bharosa Scheme — Telangana Agriculture Dept (implemented Jan 26, 2025)
verificationStatus: CORRECTED — Previous data showed wrong scheme name (Rythu Bandhu) and wrong URL (defunct). Corrected to Rythu Bharosa at ₹6,000/acre/season (₹12,000/acre/yr), new portal.

benefit: Direct cash incentive of Rs 10,000 per hectare (up to Rs 20,000 for 2 hectares maximum) directly credited to farmer bank account via DBT for cultivating notified minor millets.
eligibility: Resident farmers in Karnataka cultivating minor millets (Ragi, Foxtail millet, Little millet, Kodo millet, Proso millet, Browntop millet). Must have valid land records.
howToApply: Apply online at raitamitra.karnataka.gov.in or through Karnataka Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) with Pahani/RTC crop survey record. Field verification by local agricultural officer required.
coverage: Dryland agricultural zones across Karnataka to encourage climate-resilient water-smart grains.
officialRef: Raitha Siri Minor Millet Scheme Guidelines
verificationStatus: CONFIRMED — ₹10,000/hectare and 2 ha cap verified against raitamitra.karnataka.gov.in and multiple secondary sources.
documents: Pahani / RTC Document showing Millet sowing

benefit: 50% individual subsidy (up to 80% for Custom Hiring Centres / FPOs / Gram Panchayats) on crop residue management implements including Super SMS, Happy Seeder, Smart Seeder, Mulcher, and Straw Chopper.
eligibility: Farmers in Punjab and Haryana cultivating Paddy and Wheat with verified farm land ownership. Machinery must be purchased from empanelled manufacturers after receiving official online approval.
howToApply: Punjab: Apply at agrimachinerypb.com during active seasonal windows. Haryana: Apply at agriharyana.gov.in (linked with Meri Fasal Mera Byora). Do NOT purchase machinery before approval.
coverage: Aimed at eliminating open-field stubble burning and enhancing soil organic carbon. Applications are seasonal and subject to draw/lottery if oversubscribed.
officialSource: Punjab Dept of Agriculture (agrimachinerypb.com) / Haryana Dept (agriharyana.gov.in). PIB confirmed percentages: 50% individual, 80% CHC.
officialRef: MoAFW Central Sector Scheme for In-Situ Crop Residue Management — PIB confirmed
verificationStatus: CONFIRMED — 50%/80% subsidy split confirmed from PIB.gov.in press releases and official state portals.
